meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: Claude 会带你按三阶段协作写文档:先收集上下文并追问细节,再逐节头脑风暴、筛选、起草和修改,最后用没有上下文的 Claude 做读者测试,找出别人读不懂的地方。
howto.when: 当你提到写文档、起草提案、技术规格等,或正要开始一个较大的写作任务时,它会提议进入这套流程;你可以接受,也可以照旧自由发挥。

say.text: 我要写一份决策文档,带我走一遍这个流程
say.note: 给文档类型,进入三阶段

say.text: 先帮我按章节搭好框架,每节留占位符
用没有上下文的 Claude 测这份文档,读者会问什么

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through three stages of co-authoring a doc: gathering context, refining it section by section through brainstorming and edits, then testing it with a fresh Claude to catch what readers would miss.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you mention writing docs, drafting proposals, specs and similar tasks, or are starting a substantial writing task; it offers the workflow and you can accept or work freeform.

say_en.text: I want to write a decision doc — walk me through this workflow
Set up the section structure first, with placeholders in each
Test this doc with a fresh Claude — what would readers ask?
